title: Runner Bean Spanakopita
description: A Greek-inspired spanakopita with tender runner beans and feta cheese, perfect as a side dish or light lunch.
instructions: In a pan, heat the olive oil and sauté the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped runner beans and cook until tender.
In a bowl, crumble the feta cheese and mix with chopped dill, salt, and black pepper.
Layer the filo pastry sheets, brushing each sheet with olive oil.
Spoon the bean mixture onto one half of the pastry, then top with crumbled feta.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
